title: Nico Aris | Planeswalker
description: Learn more about the Planeswalker Niko Aris, from Magic: The Gathering.

paragraphs.text: Niko Aris is a young hero from Theros who has just begun their journey as a Planeswalker. Born to a destiny they never chose, they escaped to follow their own path through the Multiverse. A master with the javelin and other thrown weapons, Niko can create magical shards of mirror-glass capable of temporarily trapping allies or adversaries within them.
